new_standard.title: Vulcanized Acrylonitrile-Butadiene Copolymers (NBR) — Specification

new_standard.materials: Synthetic copolymer of acrylonitrile and butadiene.

new_standard.performance_requirements: Tensile strength >= 14 MPa, elongation >= 300%, volume change in IRM 903 oil <= 15%.
new_standard.testing_requirements: Mooney viscometer test per IS 3660, tensile properties per IS 3400 (Part 1), accelerated ageing per IS 3400 (Part 4).

new_standard.title: Shaving Creams and Foams — Specification
new_standard.scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for shaving creams (brush and brushless) and aerosol shaving foams.
new_standard.materials: Stearic acid, potassium hydroxide, glycerol, fatty acids, propellants.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Total fatty matter, pH of 10% solution (7.5 - 10.5), foaming power, pressure in aerosol containers, thermal stability.
new_standard.performance_requirements: Foam volume >= 100 ml, foam stability >= 90% after 5 minutes, non-corrosive to tinplate containers.

new_standard.title: Internal Combustion Engine Crankcase Oils (Automotive Applications) — Specification

new_standard.title: Automotive Vehicles — Tubes for Pneumatic Tyres — Specification
new_standard.scope: Specifies requirements, dimensions, testing and sampling for rubber inner tubes for pneumatic tyres used in automotive vehicles.
new_standard.materials: Natural rubber or butyl rubber compound with valve stem assembly.
new_standard.technical_requirements: Tensile strength, elongation at break, accelerated ageing resistance, air retention (impermeability), valve pull-out force.
